blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—Firefighters contained a diesel spill that stretched about 120 meters along Magsaysay Avenue here after a jeepney collided with a closed van on Monday, Nov. 16. The Bureau of Fire Protection – Cordillera Administrative Region (BFP-CAR) Baguio City Fire Station said personnel from Engine 9, Shift B, responded to the incident and found diesel leaking from the jeepney, with the fuel spreading along the downhill roadway. READ: Petron claims responsibility for Cavite oil spill Responders immediately contained the leak and applied sawdust to absorb the spilled diesel.
